content.title: About
content.content: Peanut butter with reduced sodium and sugar is made from roasted peanuts with less added salt and sugar. It retains the classic nutty flavor while being less salty and sweet, making it suitable for low‑sodium and low‑sugar diets.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peanut butter is a popular alternative to butter and is widely used in sports nutrition.
Reduced salt and sugar make it a better choice for people with hypertension or diabetes risk.
It is rich in monounsaturated fats, which are considered heart‑healthy.
Unlike many nut spreads, peanut butter can stay creamy without added emulsifiers.
Peanuts are legumes, not true nuts, which matters for certain nut allergy considerations.

items.title: Rich in healthy fats
items.content: The majority of fats are monounsaturated, supporting cardiovascular health.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: Approximately 25 % of the product’s weight is protein, aiding muscle repair.

items.title: Contains vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E acts as a powerful antioxidant protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: Reduced salt helps maintain healthy blood pressure levels.

items.title: Reduced sugar
items.content: Less added sugar lowers the product’s glycemic impact.

items.title: Peanut allergy
items.content: Peanut butter can trigger severe allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Despite lower sodium and sugar, it remains calorie‑dense, so portion control is important.

items.title: Aflatoxin risk
items.content: Improperly processed peanuts may contain aflatoxins; choose products from reputable manufacturers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Spread on toast, stir into smoothies, yogurt, oatmeal, or use in sauces and baked goods. For lower calorie intake, use modest portions.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. For extended shelf life, store in the refrigerator to prevent fat oxidation.
